scope: Proposition 3.2 (Selected joining laws) of the manuscript “Pointwise Multiple Ergodic Averages for Mixing Transformations” (preprints/Pointwise-Multiple-Ergodic-Averages-for-Mixing-Transformations-October-4-2026/multiple-ergodic-averages.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 154 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b9d8fcffac455475), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every flow Y over C has a unique probability law λY on Y I satisfying, for all bounded measurable functions Gi on Y , ∫︂ Y I ∏︂ i∈I Gi(yi) dλY = lim a→U ∫︂ Y 1 Na(πY y) ∫︂ Na(πY y) 0 ∏︂ i∈I Gi(Sit Y y) dt dmY (y). (3.7) Its marginals are mY , and it is invariant under (yi)i ↦→ (Sit Y yi)i, t ∈ R. If ρ : Y ′ → Y is an extension over C, then (ρI)∗λY ′ = λY . Countable inverse limits of extensions over C exist in this category. The selected law at such a limit projects to the selected law at every stage. Pullbacks of the stage selected-law spaces have dense union in L2 of the limit selected law.
